title: Braid & Compass: Seedling's Last Stand
summary: In a world threatened by warlords and eviction, a plucky teenager, defined by her asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, rises. She navigates treacherous valleys with a whacky visor, battling monstrous machines and mechanical fairies. On a scarred battlefield, she defies a pervasive hunter, connecting electrodes to a vital seedling, facing a mocking crier. Her tireless work, fueled by a fearless will, transforms a desolate country. Gathered communities celebrate her knighthood, an operatic chorus of gratitude. This workaholic's journey brings a satisfactory end to their long holdback, securing a lively, unlimited future for all.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: The plucky technician returns, greeted by kin, their makeshift home threatened by a distant warlord.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Warm golden hour light bathes a sprawling, makeshift settlement resembling a wigwam village, nestled against a jagged mountain range. In the foreground, a plucky teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is greeted by two younger figures who could be nephews. She has just jogged back, a salvaged aerial mounted on her pack. Vouchers for supplies are scattered nearby, a subtle hint of looming eviction. Her stance suggests invincibility, a sharp contrast to the weakling she once was. A distant horn sounds, warning of the warlord's pickoff raids. A keyway gate swivels open, barely maintained against the poison-laced winds.

scenes.sentence: Deep in the valleys, she navigates a failing machine, battling mechanical fairies and monstrous threats.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Cool, desaturated light. A medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, her face obscured by a whacky, makeshift visor. She wiggled through winding valleys, following a natural groove in the terrain. A monstrous contraption of geared metal and valvelets, resembling a portable hospital unit, is being savaged by small, mechanical fairies. She is trying to sample and enjoy the trade goods from a trading post, but the ticktock of a clock on the device warns of its failing power. She acts as navigator, despite being called a moron by the resident engineer. Walls of a vast, ruined city rise in the background.

scenes.sentence: On a scarred battlefield, she attaches an electrode to a seedling, defying a pervasive hunter's mockery.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Harsh rim lighting casts dramatic shadows. An extreme close-up on the teenager's hands. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is shown connecting an electrode to a delicate seedling, its roots pulsing with gravitative energy. The ground below is a scarred battlefield. Her hands are calloused, a testament to being nobody's doormat. Nearby, tattered documents flutter, evidence of hocked assets. A pervasive crier in the distance mocks her efforts, like a jailer to a prisoner. The greater hunter, wearing a collection of bizarre hats, is on a skydive, ready to bejewel the victory. She is milking every last drop of power from a multivalve device.

scenes.sentence: A transformed country rejoices, as her fearless efforts bring a satisfactory new beginning.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant concept art, 16:9 widescreen landscape. Soft, diffused light. An overhead shot reveals the landscape transformed. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now fearless, stands on a hill overlooking a newly green country. An automatic marimba plays an operatic tune as people gathered from jobcentre lines lipsync in celebration. She is no longer a flaky halfwit, but a workaholic who, with unlimited willing effort, has achieved a satisfactory outcome. A junkman, having sold off his holdback goods, now rejoins the community. Her lucky knighthood, earned through sheer lively determination, is clear to all.
